_about: The 21 short strings of one language (14 interface strings and 7 picture words), keyed by the names in sim/Strings.hpp (Strings::Key). Placeholders: {n} {percent} {title}.
PROVENANCE: machine-translated by a language model from English, terms aligned with the Magic Rampage Companion app, reviewed by a second model pass, NOT by a native speaker.
Native review is open (planning step 236, LEFT FOR THE OWNER). A key missing from this file shows the English one, and a placeholder that differs from the English one is refused for that key.

The seven picture.* keys (planning step 247) are machine translations too, with no native reader (LANG-1); none of the seven is a shortened wording chosen for the picture's box; each fits it at a readable size (tests/test_mp_overflow.cpp).
